sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Cities of Sigmar army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Cities of Sigmar units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ - or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
City Recruit | 10 | 150
City Veteran | 30 | 250
City Lord | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

If this unit was your warlord/general, you must immediately pick a new warlord/general.
Designer’s Note: In some battlepacks, if your general has been removed and you do not have another eligible unit on your roster to replace them, your warriors disp erse and your Path to Glory campaign will end. We recommend making sure you have a spare eligib le unit on your roster to avoid that scenario. Alternatively, you can take it as a sign to start a Slaves to Darkness or other Chaos army!

sections.name: You’re a Wizard!
sections.text: This Anvil of Apotheosis article enables you to forge your very own Collegiate Mage to field alongside your CITIES OF SIGMAR army. Though designed for Path to Glory campaigns, you can use your new wizard in any game if your opponent gives you the thumbs up. They may even have an Anvil of Apotheosis character of their own that they would like to use.
